equations.label: Park 2023 Eq. (16) shaft power from supply power
equations.quote: The Psupply can be calculated by multiplying the voltage and the current measured at the power supply
equations.description: Shaft power estimated from measured supply power, wire resistance (18 milliohm), inverter and motor efficiencies and mechanical loss.
assumptions: no torque transducer; shaft power inferred

claims.subject: Park 2023 inverter efficiency
claims.object: inverter output power divided by input power, speed dependent, converging to about 80%
claims.statement: Park 2023 measured inverter efficiency as inverter output power divided by input power with the pump running unloaded; it varied with rotational speed, current and voltage (strongly below 10,000 rpm) and converged to about 80%, which was assumed.
claims.quote: The ηinv was calculated by dividing the inverter output power
